evaluation.selection: Evenly spaced deterministic sample within each validation domain
evaluation.wrong_expert: Every token is evaluated against every non-selected expert via cyclic offsets; reported wrong loss is their arithmetic mean
evaluation.layerwise_wrong_expert: Only one MoE layer is corrupted at a time; all other layers retain their routed selections
evaluation.ablation_scale: Retains the trained SplitMoE output scale
